method: One mode per process. Each result is one maximum resident set size sample from /usr/bin/time, with the expected stdout checked. The producer increments an Int in a while loop, so it does not allocate an input range list.

modes.first: first() directly consumes one producer row
modes.take-first: take(1) bounds the producer before par-map
modes.par-first: first() follows par-map and cannot stop its source staging
modes.count: count() streams all producer rows without retaining them
modes.unfused: explicit reduce-by --jobs=8 keeps the intermediate par-map result
